zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, sum(a) as a, sum(b) as b, sum(c) as c, sum(d) as d, sum(e) as e, sum(f) as f, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(b_1) as b_1, sum(c_1) as c_1, sum(d_1) as d_1, sum(e_1) as e_1, sum(f_1) as f_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(b_2) as b_2, sum(c_2) as c_2, sum(d_2) as d_2, sum(e_2) as e_2, sum(f_2) as f_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(b_3) as b_3, sum(c_3) as c_3, sum(d_3) as d_3, sum(e_3) as e_3, sum(f_3) as f_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(b_4) as b_4, sum(c_4) as c_4, sum(d_4) as d_4, sum(e_4) as e_4, sum(f_4) as f_4 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

ampur.query: SELECT h.amp_code as a_code, h.amp_name as a_name, sum(a) as a, sum(b) as b, sum(c) as c, sum(d) as d, sum(e) as e, sum(f) as f, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(b_1) as b_1, sum(c_1) as c_1, sum(d_1) as d_1, sum(e_1) as e_1, sum(f_1) as f_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(b_2) as b_2, sum(c_2) as c_2, sum(d_2) as d_2, sum(e_2) as e_2, sum(f_2) as f_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(b_3) as b_3, sum(c_3) as c_3, sum(d_3) as d_3, sum(e_3) as e_3, sum(f_3) as f_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(b_4) as b_4, sum(c_4) as c_4, sum(d_4) as d_4, sum(e_4) as e_4, sum(f_4) as f_4 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.amp_code, h.amp_name ORDER BY h.amp_code

tambon.query: SELECT h.tmb_code as a_code, h.tmb_name as a_name, sum(a) as a, sum(b) as b, sum(c) as c, sum(d) as d, sum(e) as e, sum(f) as f, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(b_1) as b_1, sum(c_1) as c_1, sum(d_1) as d_1, sum(e_1) as e_1, sum(f_1) as f_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(b_2) as b_2, sum(c_2) as c_2, sum(d_2) as d_2, sum(e_2) as e_2, sum(f_2) as f_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(b_3) as b_3, sum(c_3) as c_3, sum(d_3) as d_3, sum(e_3) as e_3, sum(f_3) as f_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(b_4) as b_4, sum(c_4) as c_4, sum(d_4) as d_4, sum(e_4) as e_4, sum(f_4) as f_4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.tmb_code, h.tmb_name ORDER BY h.tmb_code

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code, CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN SUBSTRING( s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 1 ) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN SUBSTRING( s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 2 ) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END AS a_name, sum(a) as a, sum(b) as b, sum(c) as c, sum(d) as d, sum(e) as e, sum(f) as f, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(b_1) as b_1, sum(c_1) as c_1, sum(d_1) as d_1, sum(e_1) as e_1, sum(f_1) as f_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(b_2) as b_2, sum(c_2) as c_2, sum(d_2) as d_2, sum(e_2) as e_2, sum(f_2) as f_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(b_3) as b_3, sum(c_3) as c_3, sum(d_3) as d_3, sum(e_3) as e_3, sum(f_3) as f_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(b_4) as b_4, sum(c_4) as c_4, sum(d_4) as d_4, sum(e_4) as e_4, sum(f_4) as f_4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code, concat(h.hoscode, ':', h.hosname) as a_name, sum(a) as a, sum(b) as b, sum(c) as c, sum(d) as d, sum(e) as e, sum(f) as f, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(b_1) as b_1, sum(c_1) as c_1, sum(d_1) as d_1, sum(e_1) as e_1, sum(f_1) as f_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(b_2) as b_2, sum(c_2) as c_2, sum(d_2) as d_2, sum(e_2) as e_2, sum(f_2) as f_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(b_3) as b_3, sum(c_3) as c_3, sum(d_3) as d_3, sum(e_3) as e_3, sum(f_3) as f_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(b_4) as b_4, sum(c_4) as c_4, sum(d_4) as d_4, sum(e_4) as e_4, sum(f_4) as f_4 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') AND h.hdc_regist = 1 AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode
